equation_and_sign: Literal2D Eq23: r=x_j-x_i, ghat=C_i grad_i W, gp=sum V*(p_j-p_i)*ghat, F=dot(r,ghat)/r2, H_mn=sum V*((p_j-p_i)-gp dot r)*(4*r_m*r_n/r2-delta_mn)*F. Report Hxx,Hxz,Hzz and trace. Current code uses d=-r and dp=p_i-p_j. The coefficient4 and trace(D)=2 are2D only; no3D coefficient is inferred.
variants: literal_receiver_C_r2: literal receiver correction and unregularized denominator.
receiver_C_Eta2: only denominator changes to r2+Eta2.
pair_C_Eta2: F uses .5*(C_i+C_j) and Eta2; tensor trace is compared with separately accumulated current scalar lp-gp dot lx.

pair_C_Eta2_tangent_Neumann: n=(0,1),Ace=0, project gp.z to zero only for analytically tangent fields1,x,x2,cos(2pi*x). This is a pointwise compatible tangent projection diagnostic; no reconstructed normals, wall neighbors, general boundary geometry, nonzero acceleration or boundary acceptance. z/xz/z2 are excluded from this variant.
matched_identity_limit: Literal trace equals the current scalar expression only with both pair matrices replaced by the receiver C_i, Eta2=0, identical p/neighbor/volume/kernel operands and unchanged gradient target. Each actual variant also has an internal tensor/scalar expression identity check. These algebra checks do not establish discrete Eq23 accuracy, P2 exactness or an installed production operator.
arithmetic_witness: Make uses double displacements, float(rr2), actual archived float Wendland factor and double vector products. Moment accumulation and direct2x2 inverse follow current FsCorrMatInverse arithmetic, with a declared common neighbor set and V=dp2,J=1. ProductionExpression separately reproduces the XZ lp/lx/gp accumulation signs, C_i+C_j, Eta2 and compatible projection from src/source/JSphCpu.cpp::ComputeDynamicPorePressureRateCpu. It is a standalone expression witness, never an actual JSph method call or trajectory. Float pressure storage is explicitly separate: double manufactured fields and values rounded through float are both reported. Actual float factor values are shared fixed operands, not replaced by an ideal double kernel. No full paper cubic-kernel reproduction claim; current Wendland h=float(1.8dp) is intentional.
manufactured_cases: Two cloud families, ordered and deterministic integer-hash jitter bounded independently by0.08dp in X/Z, at nx16,24,32 on unit square. Fixed cell IDs, V=dp2, no neighbor-volume correction, constant isotropic k normalized to1. Fields1,x,z,x2,xz,z2,cos(2pi*x); exact analytic gradients and all three Hessian components. All receivers are classified by actual distance to domain edge versus actual support radius into interior or truncated support, separately aggregated. Conditioning and inverse/corrected-affine moment residuals are exported per receiver. No active half-run, retained raw input or physical material file is read.

predeclared_forward_roundoff_budgets.gamma: u=gamma(64*m+256)=(64*m+256)*DBL_EPSILON/(1-(64*m+256)*DBL_EPSILON), m=actual receiver neighbors. Operation count is fixed before execution. Require u*condition_inf<0.01 solely to keep this arithmetic bound informative; singular/nonpositive moments fail.
predeclared_forward_roundoff_budgets.constant: For each variant, pressure storage and cloud receiver, gp,Hxx,Hxz,Hzz and scalar expression must be exactly zero for field1. No tolerance or subtraction of measured bias.
predeclared_forward_roundoff_budgets.affine: Fixed float kernel samples are common exact operands. Gradient budget=(measured corrected-affine residual_inf+u*sum V*|Ci*g|1*|r|1)*|analytic_gradient|1 + u*sum V*|Ci*g|1*(|pi|+|pj|) + explicit float-pressure storage term FLT_EPSILON*sum V*|Ci*g|1*(|ideal_pi|+|ideal_pj|). Each component Hessian bound sums |V*D*F| times pressure subtraction/storage, |r|1*gradient budget and dot-product roundoff, plus u*sum|computed component terms|. Only affine fields x,z are gated; Neumann z is inadmissible. The observed residual and conditioning are forward-bound inputs, never fitted acceptance constants.
predeclared_forward_roundoff_budgets.matched_trace: Bound=u*(sum absolute direct Hxx/Hzz terms + sum |w*dp| + sum |w|*(|gp_x*d_x|+|gp_z*d_z|)). Require |Hxx+Hzz-separately accumulated scalar|<=bound. Zero scale requires exact equality. Field1 additionally has exact null. No absolute floor or result-tuned multiplier.
predeclared_forward_roundoff_budgets.quadratic_and_smooth: Report component/trace/scalar errors and pressure quantization separately. affine_forward_bound_applicable is true only for x/z; computed bound columns for other fields are not Hessian accuracy bounds. Apply no quadratic exactness, 1percent accuracy or convergence-order threshold. Root may calculate observed error ratios using actual dp ratios across the three predeclared spacings; failure to converge is retained evidence, never hidden by trace alone.

periodic_matrix: Independent8x8 unit-periodic ordered/jitter cloud, unique minimum-image support,64nodes, all three unprojected variants. Export full matrices by exact basis application, row sums, V-weighted column sums, max|A-A^T|, Frobenius norm, matrix bytes and cumulative wall time. Constant-input null is exact; matrix row-sum floating reduction, conservation and symmetry values are descriptive. Root may load periodic_matrix.csv and use NumPy eigvalsh((A+A.T)/2) per cloud/variant, reporting both signs and magnitude with a forward numerical-scale explanation. No C++ eigensolver, eigenvalue claim, symmetric-negative-semidefinite gate, global-conservation claim or extra artifact is authored here.
